rules.statement: A party applying to re-open a preliminary decree must give security for the costs incurred by other parties if they have delayed in ascertaining their proper share and failing to file an answer setting forth their claim.
rules.supporting_quote: In a partition suit, a party applying to re-open the preliminary decree, on the ground of there being a mistake as to the share assigned to him, may be called upon to give security for the costs incurred by the other parties, if he has delayed to ascertain his proper share and to apprise the Court in time of the mistake.
